edges.reason: Dark oak logs provide planks for crafting table access; ensures player has explored northern zone before final craft.
Oak logs provide additional wood resources; ensures player has explored northern grove before crafting.
Player must navigate to southern treasure zone where iron block and crafting table are co-located; confirms player has reached the crafting area.
Gray concrete powder at (-8,0,2) is 2 blocks from orange stained glass at (-8,0,4); finding the landmark naturally leads to discovering the adjacent glass structure.

milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The gray concrete powder is at (-8, 0, 2) relative to spawn (~8.2 blocks away). max_distance=5 forces the player to actually walk west toward the target rather than satisfying the condition from spawn. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the block, modeling 'player can see the target'.

Uses inventory_has because mining oak_log drops oak_log as an item which ends up in the player's inventory. Oak logs always drop themselves regardless of tool used, so checking inventory is the most direct verification.
Uses inventory_has because mining dark_oak_log drops dark_oak_log as an item which ends up in the player's inventory. Dark oak logs always drop themselves regardless of tool used.

Uses inventory_has because the player has a Silk Touch iron pickaxe, which causes orange stained glass to drop itself as an item when mined. Without Silk Touch glass shatters with no drop, but the scene provides Silk Touch so inventory_has is the correct and clean check.

Uses inventory_has because mining emerald_block with an iron pickaxe drops the emerald_block itself as an item. Emerald blocks always drop themselves when mined with appropriate tier tool (iron+), regardless of Silk Touch enchantment.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The iron block is at (2, 0, 8) relative to spawn (~8.2 blocks away). max_distance=5 forces the player to walk south toward the target. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the iron block, modeling 'player can see the target'.
Uses inventory_has because mining a fletching_table drops the fletching_table item which ends up in inventory. Fletching tables can be broken with any tool or bare hands and always drop themselves.

Uses inventory_has because crafting iron_boots places the item in the player's inventory. The player starts with exactly 4 iron ingots (the exact recipe requirement) and a crafting table is available at (0,0,8) in the southern zone. This is not in starting inventory so its presence confirms successful crafting.

scene_description: A compact clearing with four distinct zones arranged around the player spawn. North has a small grove of dark oak and oak trees. East has a workshop area with a fletching table. South has a treasure area with iron block and crafting table. West has a decorative structure with gray concrete powder foundation, orange stained glass windows, and an emerald block display. All zones are within 15 blocks of spawn and connected by clear paths on flat grass terrain.
task_text: Explore this clearing: mine dark oak and oak logs from the northern grove, find the gray concrete powder landmark in the west and mine the nearby orange stained glass and emerald block, find the iron block in the south, mine the fletching table in the east, then craft iron boots at the southern crafting table.
